---

Describe the peptides and the CDR3 sequences. Save plots under `results/`.

Lengths are counted on the peptide table before the HLA join, so a peptide isn't counted once per allele.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

dir.create(here("results"), showWarnings = FALSE)

peptide_data <- read_tsv(here("data", "02_dat_clean.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    k_CDR3b = str_length(CDR3b),
    k_peptide = str_length(peptide)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.4
#| fig-cap: "CDR3b lengths after splitting the peptide list."

p_cdr3 <- peptide_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = k_CDR3b)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  xlab("CDR3b length") +
  ylab("Counts") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  here("results", "cdr3_length.png"),
  p_cdr3,
  width = 6,
  height = 3.4,
  dpi = 120
)

p_cdr3
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.4
#| fig-cap: "Peptide lengths. 9-mers are the common ones."

p_pep <- peptide_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = k_peptide)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, color = "black", fill = "grey") +
  xlab("Peptide length") +
  ylab("Counts") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  here("results", "peptide_length.png"),
  p_pep,
  width = 6,
  height = 3.4,
  dpi = 120
)

p_pep
```
